clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Forgotten Pools, Barak Kodobane's severed head proves the cunning chieftain's death. The orc warlord Regthar Deathgate receives it as proof that the centaur threat there has been broken.

Kolkar bands in the Barrens have long been divided, but ambitious warlords now threaten to gather them into an army. Barak Kodobane made his camp by the lush waters of the Forgotten Pools, where the oasis offers vital resources and nearby paths lie open to raids. Regthar Deathgate, stationed in a bunker west of the Crossroads, demands Kodobane's severed head as proof that this commander can no longer rally his kin against the Horde.
